### Hell Bent
Author: Kevin DeYoung
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/kevin-deyoung/hell-bent/
Passage: Revelation 12:1-6
Points:
- Christians and local churches continually face tragedy, internal strife, and external opposition.
- While human sin, a fallen world, and divine sovereignty explain suffering, an unseen spiritual war also rages.
- Revelation 12 pulls back the curtain to reveal Satan's fierce hatred against the gospel and God's people.
- Believers have ultimate hope because Christ was born to vanquish the dragon and shepherd the nations.
